content.message: I'll run an ASK query that looks for a shared country value for the two universities, checking both dbp:country and dbo:country properties (so it still works if DBpedia uses either property). If the ASK returns true, they are in the same country; otherwise not. Now I'll execute that final SPARQL query.

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>

ASK WHERE {
  { dbr:Yanbian_University_of_Science_and_Technology dbp:country ?c } UNION { dbr:Yanbian_University_of_Science_and_Technology dbo:country ?c } .
  { dbr:Southwest_Minzu_University dbp:country ?c } UNION { dbr:Southwest_Minzu_University dbo:country ?c } .
}
args.answer: Both universities have the same country value (China). Yes — they are located in the same country (China).
